svg.title: FIDOM proposed core architecture
svg.desc: Deterministic sim and server, separate ATProto bridge, PDS edge, and the trust boundary between them.
svg.text: v0.4 deterministic sim + proposed PDS bridge. The bridge can submit intents; it never holds &mut World.
one clock · one state · one log

text.tspan: no clock · no network · no filesystem · no threads

svg.text: Bridge may submit Intents and receive BridgeEvents; it never holds &mut World.
